purpose: Diagnostic numerical MNIST4 forward chain from scalar-binary DMD geometry through an ideal single phase screen and finite-pupil 4f imaging to CMOS pixel-area integration and fixed 2x2 ROI classification.

source_files.parameter_baseline: research_assets/lightgen/HW207_实物与距离基线_20261103/实物信息与闭环状态.md

population.source_role: existing C0 validation indices in original order

dmd.command_model: SCALAR_BINARY_APPROXIMATION; ON=1 and OFF=0 are numerical labels only

input_relay.geometry: C3-A/B/C ideal 4f candidates from C2.1; not installed or calibrated
input_relay.map_method: C2.1 polygon-area projection of square active mirror regions onto the 100x100 target input grid
input_relay.field_assumption: uniform coherent phase; complex amplitude is sqrt(mapped irradiance)

lightgen_target_model.implementation: v2 FiniteCropPhaseStack with one frozen zero-phase layer, finite-crop boundary and zero numerical propagation distance
lightgen_target_model.status: IDEAL_TARGET_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; not a fabricated LightGen model or measured complex transmission

output_relay.clear_aperture_status: DIAGNOSTIC_ASSUMPTION derived from 0.2 cycles/um source-side cutoff at f1=30 mm; lens clear aperture is UNKNOWN
output_relay.status: IDEAL_4F_WITH_CIRCULAR_PUPIL; 50 um defocus is a sensitivity case, not measured

cmos.candidate_model: Gpixel GSENSE2020 screenshot specification; actual installed identity UNKNOWN
cmos.response: IDEAL_LINEAR_PIXEL_AREA_INTEGRAL; arbitrary relative energy, no QE/noise/gain/exposure/ADC/saturation
cmos.roi_geometry: fixed sensor-pixel envelope of the projected 200 um LightGen image region, split into equal 2x2 half-open rectangles; centered zero-offset diagnostic mapping
cmos.low_signal_status: only numerical-zero and tie abstention are defined; physical threshold UNKNOWN
